name: RealisticComicBook_LORA_FLUX
description: Trained on images generated by my old sd 1.5 REALISTIC COMIC BOOK model. I haven't done a lot of testing. A weight between 0.9 and 1.5 seems correct. The rendering of lines and colors is much less natural than I hoped but it's a good start. Oriented on a classic, old school and realistic style. More reminiscent of European comics rather than manga or American comics.
